_comment: Policy, not code. Basenames whose presence in a diff forces a sign-off. Matched on BASENAME because dispatches run in scratch worktrees -- the directory a file sits in during a job says nothing about where it lands.
_auto_comment: Autonomous sign-off. auto_approve.requires are DECIDABLE conditions that must ALL hold -- no model opinion appears anywhere, deliberately: 'a reviewer model said it looked fine' is the same vacuous acceptance rule as 'the repro fired'. never_auto is the carve-out that makes it safe, checked FIRST and unsatisfiable by evidence. Two kinds of file belong in it: (a) the CHECKERS -- weaken verify-quality and it approves itself and everything after; (b) the EVIDENCE PRODUCERS -- ollama-worker.py enforces the verify gate and ollama-queue.py is what SETS verify_failed_at_baseline, the load-bearing condition, so a change to either could falsify the very evidence auto_decide trusts. Surfacing counts too (handoff-emit, queue-api): a change that hides a row erases the gate as effectively as one that disables it.
_widen_comment: 2026-09-02, the owner's GO on option 1. basenames/path_globs now cover risk-bearing PRODUCT code (data-destruction, money, access) in addition to gate machinery. These entries are deliberately ABSENT from never_auto: product code is not the gate, so it is exactly the domain autonomous sign-off was built for. path_globs is new -- the highest-risk handlers are named route.ts and cannot be addressed by basename without firing on every route in every app.
_signer_comment: 2026-09-02: Fable retired as signer per the owner ("we don't need fable to sign off on final code"). The sign-off REQUIREMENT is unchanged -- the owner GO'd the widening the same day; only who signs changed. Entries in signoff.json that already carry a Fable verdict were left alone: they record a decision that was actually made.
_autonomy_comment: 2026-09-03: three new auto_approve keys, every one CONSUMED by signoff.py (grep the key name; the canary asserts it). mode: 'shadow' logs the harness decision beside the human's and never acts; 'live' acts. ABSENT MEANS SHADOW. relevance: floor on the preflight ledger's verify_relevance (mutation kill score) -- a verify that lets property-breaking mutants of the refimpl pass cannot certify a fix. safe_classes.bounded_single_site: the ONLY auto-approvable change class -- one file, few hunks, small, no new/deleted files. security_adjacent_patterns: regexes matched against the diff's file PATHS and its changed lines (added AND removed); any hit routes to a human. Err toward matching -- a false hit costs a look, a miss auto-approves a credential change. Widen any of these by measured --agreement over real dispatches, never by argument.
